sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS We estimate that the net proceeds from the sale of the shares of common stock that we are offering will be approximately $429.0 million, based on the
offering price of $28.50 per share and after deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us. We will
retain broad discretion over the use of the net proceeds from the sale of the securities offered hereby. We currently intend to use the net proceeds of this offering for research and development, general corporate expenses and working capital needs.
As of the date of this prospectus supplement, we cannot specify with certainty all of the particular uses for the net proceeds to us from this offering. sections.excerpt:

determined by subtracting our total liabilities from our total tangible assets and dividing the result by the number of shares of our common stock outstanding as of September 30, 2023. Dilution in net tangible book value per share represents
the difference between the amount per share paid by purchasers of shares of common stock in this offering and the net tangible book value per share of our common stock immediately after this offering.
